title: What is SORA?
subtitle: Turn scattered opinions into clear product decisions.

hero.headline: What is SORA?
hero.body: SORA gives every voice a place — structured, weighted, and connected to real execution.

flow.label: How it works
flow.headline: From idea to execution, step by step.

steps.title: Share ideas
steps.body: Anyone on the team submits ideas through a simple, guided form.

steps.title: Gather input
steps.body: Stakeholders vote and comment. Every opinion is captured — nothing gets lost.

steps.title: Make decisions
steps.body: Product leaders decide with full context: weighted votes, trends, and impact scores.

steps.title: Build it
steps.body: Approved ideas flow directly into ClickUp as structured tasks, ready for execution.

steps.title: Stay informed
steps.body: Everyone sees what was decided and why. No more wondering what happened to your idea.

items.label: Not a ticketing tool
items.body: Use Freshservice for bugs and support requests.

items.label: Not a backlog manager
items.body: Backlogs live in ClickUp. SORA feeds them.

items.label: Not a support system
items.body: SORA is about product direction, not issue resolution.

whoFor.label: Roles
whoFor.headline: Built for both sides of the table.

items: See what gets built and why

trust.label: The promise
trust.headline: Your ideas don't disappear.
trust.body: In SORA, every idea is tracked, evaluated, and resolved — with a clear explanation. No black holes.
